title: The Confidence Trap: Gender Bias and Predictive Certainty in LLMs
findings: The paper's findings are not related to religion. The analysis is focused on gender bias, showing that models like Gemma-2-9B have poor calibration for gendered predictions, while GPT-J-6B is better calibrated. The paper finds that most LLMs are less calibrated for female pronouns, revealing a bias toward male references.
